title: Warlocks #6 Aircel Comics 1989 Painted Portrait Cover Warlock 5 Spinoff Comic
conditionDescription: Covers bright with no tears. A horizontal crease across the left side of the front cover and small spine stress marks (see photo 2). Staples intact. Priced for condition. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlocks #6 (1989), Aircel Comics - the Warlock 5 spinoff series, with a painted portrait cover. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.50 in Canada).

Back cover: Dinosaurs for Hire ad from Eternity Comics.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
